link.quote: My leaving still leaves four here, so one more person moving elsewhere would avoid the extra heat use; North House has offered company.

proposedRemedy.quote: The cold snap gives us something practical to plan for: one workshop shift per cycle replaces the ordinary heat use.

enactedRemedy.act: moved to North House at c27, which ended the cycle with three in South House (first shifts c28)
enactedRemedy.quote: I'll visit North House this cycle so we avoid the extra heat use.
